sections.section_title: TIM15 DMA address for full transfer (TIM15_DMAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 20.5.18 "TIM15 DMA address for full transfer (TIM15_DMAR)" in chapter 20 (General-purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 604.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x4C
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:0 DMAB[15:0]: DMA register for burst accesses
A read or write operation to the DMAR register accesses the register located at the address
(TIMx_CR1 address) + (DBA + DMA index) x 4
where TIMx_CR1 address is the address of the control register 1, DBA is the DMA base
address configured in TIMx_DCR register, DMA index is automatically controlled by the
DMA transfer, and ranges from 0 to DBL (DBL configured in TIMx_DCR).
